name: 36 - API - Process Post Visit Followup Response - Standalone Final

nodes.name: Normalize and Validate Post Visit Response

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS followup_token,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS recovery_status,
        $4::INTEGER AS pain_level,
        $5::BOOLEAN AS has_red_flag,
        $6::TEXT AS red_flag_details,
        $7::BOOLEAN AS has_medication_issue,
        $8::TEXT AS medication_issue_details,
        $9::BOOLEAN AS has_complaint,
        $10::TEXT AS complaint_details,
        $11::INTEGER AS satisfaction_score,
        $12::TEXT AS patient_comment
),

followup_context AS (
    SELECT
        followup.id AS followup_id,
        followup.appointment_id,
        followup.followup_stage,
        followup.status AS followup_status,
        followup.expires_at,

        appointment.clinic_id,
        appointment.doctor_id,
        appointment.patient_id,
        appointment.service_id,
        appointment.starts_at,
        appointment.ends_at,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,
        service.name AS service_name,

        request.recovery_status,
        request.pain_level,
        request.has_red_flag,
        request.red_flag_details,
        request.has_medication_issue,
        request.medication_issue_details,
        request.has_complaint,
        request.complaint_details,
        request.satisfaction_score,
        request.patient_comment,

        CASE
            WHEN request.has_red_flag = TRUE
              OR request.pain_level >= 9
                THEN 'urgent'

            WHEN request.has_medication_issue = TRUE
              OR request.pain_level >= 7
              OR (
                    request.recovery_status = 'worse'
                    AND request.pain_level >= 5
                 )
                THEN 'high'

            WHEN request.recovery_status = 'worse'
              OR request.pain_level >= 5
              OR request.has_complaint = TRUE
              OR request.satisfaction_score <= 2
                THEN 'medium'

            ELSE 'low'
        END AS risk_level,

        CASE
            WHEN request.has_red_flag = TRUE
              OR request.has_medication_issue = TRUE
              OR request.recovery_status = 'worse'
              OR request.pain_level >= 5
              OR request.has_complaint = TRUE
              OR request.satisfaction_score <= 2
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS needs_human_review,

        CASE
            WHEN request.has_red_flag = TRUE
              OR request.has_medication_issue = TRUE
              OR request.recovery_status = 'worse'
              OR request.pain_level >= 5
                THEN 'medical_review'
            WHEN request.has_complaint = TRUE
              OR request.satisfaction_score <= 2
                THEN 'complaint'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS handoff_task_type

    FROM appointment_post_visit_followups followup

    INNER JOIN appointments appointment
        ON appointment.id = followup.appointment_id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = appointment.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = appointment.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = appointment.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = appointment.service_id

    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.followup_token =
           followup.followup_token
       AND request.mobile = patient.mobile

    WHERE followup.status = 'pending'

    LIMIT 1
),

expired_followup AS (
    UPDATE appointment_post_visit_followups followup

    SET
        status = 'expired',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM followup_context context

    WHERE followup.id = context.followup_id
      AND context.expires_at <= NOW()

    RETURNING followup.id
),

inserted_handoff AS (
    INSERT INTO human_handoff_tasks (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,

        task_type,
        source_type,
        source_record_id,

        priority,
        status,

        reason,
        due_at
    )

    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        context.appointment_id,

        context.handoff_task_type,
        'appointment',
        context.appointment_id,

        CASE context.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN 'urgent'
            WHEN 'high' THEN 'high'
            ELSE 'normal'
        END,

        'open',

        CASE
            WHEN context.handoff_task_type = 'medical_review'
                THEN CONCAT(
                    'پاسخ پیگیری پس از مراجعه نیازمند بررسی انسانی است. ',
                    'وضعیت بهبود: ',
                    context.recovery_status,
                    '، شدت درد: ',
                    context.pain_level,
                    '.'
                )

            WHEN context.handoff_task_type = 'complaint'
                THEN 'پاسخ پیگیری پس از مراجعه شامل شکایت یا رضایت پایین بیمار است.'

            ELSE 'پیگیری پس از مراجعه نیازمند بررسی انسانی است.'
        END,

        CASE context.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN NOW()
            WHEN 'high' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes'
            ELSE NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours'
        END

    FROM followup_context context

    WHERE context.expires_at > NOW()
      AND context.needs_human_review = TRUE
      AND context.handoff_task_type IS NOT NULL

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS handoff_task_id,
        task_type,
        priority,
        due_at
),

effective_handoff AS (
    SELECT
        inserted.handoff_task_id,
        inserted.task_type,
        inserted.priority,
        inserted.due_at

    FROM inserted_handoff inserted

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        existing.id AS handoff_task_id,
        existing.task_type,
        existing.priority,
        existing.due_at

    FROM human_handoff_tasks existing

    INNER JOIN followup_context context
        ON existing.source_type = 'appointment'
       AND existing.source_record_id =
           context.appointment_id
       AND existing.task_type =
           context.handoff_task_type

    WHERE context.needs_human_review = TRUE

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inserted_handoff
      )

    ORDER BY handoff_task_id
    LIMIT 1
),

updated_followup AS (
    UPDATE appointment_post_visit_followups followup

    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN context.needs_human_review = TRUE
                THEN 'escalated'
            ELSE 'completed'
        END,

        responded_at = NOW(),

        recovery_status =
            context.recovery_status,

        pain_level =
            context.pain_level,

        has_red_flag =
            context.has_red_flag,

        red_flag_details =
            NULLIF(
                context.red_flag_details,
                ''
            ),

        has_medication_issue =
            context.has_medication_issue,

        medication_issue_details =
            NULLIF(
                context.medication_issue_details,
                ''
            ),

        has_complaint =
            context.has_complaint,

        complaint_details =
            NULLIF(
                context.complaint_details,
                ''
            ),

        satisfaction_score =
            context.satisfaction_score,

        patient_comment =
            NULLIF(
                context.patient_comment,
                ''
            ),

        risk_level =
            context.risk_level,

        needs_human_review =
            context.needs_human_review,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM followup_context context

    WHERE followup.id = context.followup_id
      AND context.expires_at > NOW()

    RETURNING
        followup.id AS followup_id,
        followup.appointment_id,
        followup.followup_stage,
        followup.status AS followup_status,
        followup.responded_at,
        followup.risk_level,
        followup.needs_human_review
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM followup_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expired_followup
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
        )
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM followup_context
        )
            THEN 'post_visit_followup_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expired_followup
        )
            THEN 'post_visit_followup_expired'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE
              AND risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'urgent_human_review_required'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE
              AND risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'high_priority_review_required'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'human_review_required'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
        )
            THEN 'post_visit_followup_completed'

        ELSE 'post_visit_response_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM followup_context
        )
            THEN 'پیگیری فعال مطابق توکن و شماره موبایل پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expired_followup
        )
            THEN 'زمان اعتبار این پیگیری به پایان رسیده است.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE
              AND risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'پاسخ بیمار ثبت شد و برای بررسی فوری انسانی ارجاع گردید.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE
              AND risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'پاسخ بیمار ثبت شد و برای بررسی با اولویت بالا ارجاع گردید.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'پاسخ بیمار ثبت شد و برای پیگیری انسانی ارجاع گردید.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
        )
            THEN 'پاسخ پیگیری پس از مراجعه با موفقیت ثبت شد.'

        ELSE 'وضعیت پیگیری در فاصله بررسی تا ثبت پاسخ تغییر کرده است.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT followup_id
        FROM updated_followup
    ) AS followup_id,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM followup_context
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT followup_stage
        FROM followup_context
    ) AS followup_stage,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM followup_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM followup_context
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM followup_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM followup_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT risk_level
        FROM updated_followup
    ) AS risk_level,

    (
        SELECT needs_human_review
        FROM updated_followup
    ) AS needs_human_review,

    (
        SELECT handoff_task_id
        FROM effective_handoff
    ) AS handoff_task_id,

    (
        SELECT task_type
        FROM effective_handoff
    ) AS handoff_task_type,

    (
        SELECT priority
        FROM effective_handoff
    ) AS handoff_priority,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE risk_level = 'urgent'
              AND needs_human_review = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'urgent_human_handoff'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_followup
            WHERE needs_human_review = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'human_handoff'

        ELSE 'no_action'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

nodes.name: Return Post Visit Response Validation Error

parameters.content:
## پردازش پاسخ بیمار پس از مراجعه

توکن را از خروجی Workflow شماره 35 بردار.

اطلاعات جمع‌آوری‌شده:
- وضعیت بهبود: better / same / worse
- شدت درد: 0 تا 10
- علامت هشدار
- مشکل دارویی
- شکایت
- رضایت: 1 تا 5

Workflow توصیه پزشکی تولید نمی‌کند؛ فقط پاسخ را ثبت، سطح ریسک را تعیین و در صورت نیاز تسک انسانی ایجاد می‌کند.
